hooks.name: Block writes containing API key patterns
hooks.description: Flags any file write that contains sk-ant-, sk-, xai-, or omk_ followed by a long string (potential secrets per security.md)

action.command: input=$(cat); if echo "$input" | grep -qP '(sk-ant-|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{8,}|xai-[a-zA-Z0-9]{8,}|omk_[a-zA-Z0-9]{8,})'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Potential API key detected in file write. Verify no real secret is being committed."}}'; fi; exit 0
